summary: Draft Session Manager Kernel DPC watchdog control timeout cluster record. Repo docs list `DPCTimeout = 20000`, `DpcSoftTimeout = 20000`, and `DpcCumulativeSoftTimeout = 120000` under `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Kernel`. Current-build KVM local-KD disassembly already proves that the corresponding globals are real reader and writer participants: `KeQueryDpcWatchdogConfiguration` reads them, `KiValidateDpcWatchdogConfiguration` backfills and validates them, and `KeUpdateDpcWatchdogConfiguration` writes them from caller-supplied validated input. A later PDB-backed Ghidra symbol-xref pass further narrowed the caller story by tying `KeUpdateDpcWatchdogConfiguration` to `NtSetSystemInformation`. The family is real, but it still lacks dedicated live current-build value reads and a demonstrated persisted registry seeding caller.

setting.professional_notes: Repo docs list three `Session Manager\Kernel` DPC watchdog control timeout defaults: `DPCTimeout = 20000`, `DpcSoftTimeout = 20000`, and `DpcCumulativeSoftTimeout = 120000`. Current-build KVM local-KD disassembly already proves that the corresponding globals are structurally real on the running build. `KeQueryDpcWatchdogConfiguration` reads `KeDpcTimeoutMs`, `KeDpcSoftTimeoutMs`, and `KeDpcCumulativeSoftTimeoutMs` and only emits them when the globals are non-zero. `KiValidateDpcWatchdogConfiguration` backfills missing fields from the same globals and enforces ordering/range checks. `KeUpdateDpcWatchdogConfiguration` is the explicit writer that updates the globals from caller-supplied validated input before downstream processor-limit assembly. A later PDB-backed Ghidra symbol-xref pass tightened the caller story by showing that `NtSetSystemInformation` references `KeUpdateDpcWatchdogConfiguration`, while `KiInitializeProcessor` references the downstream `KiCreateDpcLimitsProcessorConfiguration` consumer. This is strong structural evidence for the family, but it still stops short of validated registry semantics because the live current-build values for these three globals have not yet been directly read and no persisted `Session Manager\Kernel` seeding caller has yet been shown above the writer path.
